title: Senior ServiceNow Developer – ITSM | CSM | Service Catalog | Integrations
description:
**Senior ServiceNow Developer – ITSM | CSM | Service Catalog | Integrations**

**Claidroid — Pune, Maharashtra, India**

**Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
6–8 Years

**Open Positions:**
2

We're Hiring: Senior ServiceNow Developer

**Build enterprise solutions. Work on international projects. Take your ServiceNow career to the next level.**

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for experienced
**Senior ServiceNow Developers**
to join our growing enterprise technology practice for a strategic engagement with a leading global organization.

We are seeking technically proficient professionals with strong hands-on expertise in
**ServiceNow ITSM, Customer Service Management (CSM), Service Catalog, Flow Designer, JavaScript and Enterprise Integrations**
.

The role offers an opportunity to design, develop and enhance scalable ServiceNow solutions that improve IT service delivery, automate business processes and strengthen enterprise customer service capabilities.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, developing high-quality platform solutions and collaborating with international technology teams.

**About Claidroid Technologies**

**Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a global digital transformation and enterprise technology services partner built around Cloud, AI, Automation and Enterprise Platforms.**

We collaborate with leading global enterprises to modernize technology ecosystems, improve operational efficiency and deliver scalable, secure and innovative digital solutions.

Our technology capabilities span:

* ServiceNow & Enterprise Service Management
* Cloud Engineering & Digital Transformation
* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Identity & Access Management
* DevOps, DevSecOps & AIOps
* Data Engineering & Enterprise Integration

At Claidroid, we believe meaningful technology careers are built through
**challenging assignments, international exposure, continuous learning and ownership of business-critical solutions**
.

Our professionals work alongside experienced engineers, architects and technology consultants, gaining exposure to enterprise-scale implementations and global delivery standards.

**Role Overview**

As a
**Senior ServiceNow Developer**
, you will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing and supporting ServiceNow solutions across IT Service Management, Service Catalog, Customer Service Management and enterprise integrations.

You will work closely with Product Owners, technical architects and cross-functional Agile teams to translate business requirements into scalable platform capabilities.

The role requires strong expertise in
**ServiceNow application development, scripting, workflow automation, platform architecture, integrations and production support**
.

You will contribute to technical solution design, development, testing, deployment and continuous improvement while ensuring adherence to ServiceNow best practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ServiceNow Development & Customization**

* Design, develop and enhance ServiceNow applications across ITSM, CSM and Service Catalog.
* Develop Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes and UI Policies using JavaScript and Glide APIs.
* Configure Catalog Items, Record Producers, forms and application functionality.
* Build automated workflows using ServiceNow Flow Designer.
* Develop reusable components and maintainable solutions aligned with ServiceNow best practices.
* Optimize existing platform functionality to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.

**Customer Service Management & Service Catalog**

* Configure and enhance ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) capabilities.
* Support customer service workflows, case-management processes and service delivery requirements.
* Design and maintain Service Catalog solutions supporting business and IT services.
* Automate service request fulfilment and approval workflows.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate functional requirements into effective ServiceNow configurations.

**Enterprise Integrations & Automation**

* Design, develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise applications.
* Implement REST and SOAP web service integrations.
* Develop integration workflows using ServiceNow IntegrationHub and third-party APIs.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, connectivity issues and data exchange problems.
* Identify opportunities to improve process automation and reduce manual operational effort.

**Testing, Deployment & Production Support**

* Perform unit testing, code reviews and technical validation.
* Investigate and resolve application defects and production issues.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
* Support production deployments, platform enhancements and operational activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records and knowledge articles.
* Ensure platform stability, maintainability and adherence to development standards.

**Agile Delivery & Technical Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum teams and technical stakeholders.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement and Agile ceremonies.
* Provide effort estimates and deliver development activities within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to technical discussions, solution reviews and continuous platform improvement.
* Demonstrate accountability, ownership and strong problem-solving capabilities.

**Must-Have Skills**

**ServiceNow Platform Expertise**

* **6–8 years of relevant experience**
  , preferably including 7–8 years of hands-on ServiceNow development, implementation and support.
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM).
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM).
* Strong knowledge of Service Catalog and Catalog Management.
* Experience designing Catalog Items, Record Producers and automated workflows.
* Good understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture and development best practices.

**ServiceNow Development & Scripting**

* Strong JavaScript programming and scripting capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with Glide APIs.
* Expertise in Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes and UI Policies.
* Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer and workflow configuration.
* Ability to develop scalable, reusable and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.

**Integrations & Technical Support**

* Experience developing REST and SOAP integrations.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow IntegrationHub and third-party API connectivity.
* Experience troubleshooting application and integration issues.
* Understanding of unit testing, code reviews and production deployments.
* Strong root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving skills.

**Agile & Professional Competencies**

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Strong analytical and solution-design capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to independently own technical deliverables.
* Adaptability, continuous learning and commitment to technical excellence.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

Candidates with additional expertise in the following areas will have an advantage:

* **ServiceNow Certifications:**
  Certified System Administrator (CSA) and/or Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* **IT Asset Management (ITAM):**
  Exposure to ServiceNow asset management capabilities.
* **CMDB:**
  Understanding of Configuration Management Database concepts.
* **Service Mapping:**
  Knowledge of ServiceNow Service Mapping and associated platform capabilities.
* **Enterprise Implementations:**
  Experience supporting large-scale ServiceNow programmes and global technology environments.

**Why Join Claidroid Technologies?**

**International Exposure. Enterprise Technology. Meaningful Career Growth.**

Joining Claidroid gives you the opportunity to expand beyond routine development and contribute to sophisticated ServiceNow implementations for global enterprises.

**Work on international enterprise projects**

Collaborate with technology teams and stakeholders in global business environments, gaining exposure to large-scale implementations, modern delivery practices and enterprise technology standards.

**Deepen your ServiceNow expertise**

Strengthen your technical capabilities across ITSM, CSM, Service Catalog, advanced scripting, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub and enterprise application integration.

**Expand your engineering capabilities**

Work on challenging solutions involving platform customization, workflow automation, system integration and application optimization.

**Collaborate with experienced professionals**

Learn from skilled engineers, architects and consultants while contributing your own expertise to important technology initiatives.

**Build a stronger professional profile**

Develop the technical judgment, consulting capabilities, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills that prepare you for increasingly complex enterprise technology responsibilities.

**Grow with an evolving technology organization**

Be part of a company focused on Cloud, AI, Automation and Enterprise Platforms, where innovation, accountability, continuous learning and professional excellence are valued.

At Claidroid, our goal is to create opportunities that help talented professionals
**broaden their experience, strengthen their capabilities and advance toward the next level of their careers**
.

Work Location

**Pune, Maharashtra, India**

Candidates should be willing to work from the designated project location in accordance with business and project requirements.

Apply Now

**Your next career milestone could begin with Claidroid Technologies.**

If you have strong hands-on expertise in
**ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, Service Catalog, JavaScript, Flow Designer and enterprise integrations**
, we would like to hear from you.

Join Claidroid Technologies and contribute to building scalable, intelligent and high-quality ServiceNow solutions for global enterprises.

**Key Skills:**
ServiceNow | Senior ServiceNow Developer | ITSM | CSM | Customer Service Management | Service Catalog | Catalog Management | Flow Designer | Workflow Automation | JavaScript | Glide API | Business Rules | Client Scripts | Script Includes | UI Policies | Catalog Items | Record Producers | IntegrationHub | REST API | SOAP API | Enterprise Integrations | ITAM | CMDB | Service Mapping | Agile | Scrum | ServiceNow CSA | ServiceNow CAD

title: SENIOR MLM L3
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description
**Role Purpose**
The purpose of this role is to increase revenue, maximize process efficiency & cost-effectiveness, and ensure excellent customer experience, through effective leadership and supervision of daily operations and personnel, strategy planning, contract compliance, resource optimization and capability development for an account. ͏
**Do**

* **Maximize process efficiency and cost effectiveness through strategic planning, contract compliance and governance mechanisms**
* Strategy Planning with Senior Stakeholders & Clients
  + Collaborate with leaders to provide strategic and operational plans associated with the account
  + Plan the strategy for the coming years by identifying new geographies for alternate revenue streams
  + Collaborate with clients and identify countries that need to be mapped to bring revenues for the same product
  + Part of internal WIPRO leadership planning meeting to discuss revenue numbers for the account
  + Report to global delivery account head on status of the account
  + Ensure a deep enough understanding of clients individual experiences to head off potential issues before they become problems
* Contract compliance & adherence
  + Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account and maintain a green card at all times
  + Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non-compliances are cited
  + Monitor and review the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines

͏

* Delivery governance in the account
  + Understand customer goals and key performance metrics and ensure exceeding those goals throughout the project
  + Ensure a green card for all accounts in terms of performance and quality
  + Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress and identify potential red flags
  + Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal and external stakeholders
  + Lead and manage project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
  + Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition
  + Forecast and track key account metrics

͏

* **Invoicing**
  + Timely submission of invoices to the client as defined in the SOW
  + Provide information required and resolve any invoicing issues raised by the client
* Work with internal teams by supporting activities such as RFP response, doing use capability demonstrations, and participating in the customer calls to sell solutions
* Identify opportunities for quick wins through automation and related initiatives in the account (wherever applicable)
* Collect and analyze statistics (costs, customer service metrics etc.)
* Assume responsibility of budgeting and tracking expenses

͏

* **Ensure outstanding performance against key metrics mentioned in the agreement**
  + Regular cadence around contract compliance
    - Evaluate performance with key metrics (accuracy, customer service metrics etc.)
    - Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as required
    - Drive the focus of the team on quality and adherence to contract compliance processes
    - Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional
    - Cadence with delivery lead to ensure margins are met and the account numbers are at par to what is committed
    - Weekly calls with WFM to ensure resource optimization, compliance to the manpower numbers agreed in the contract, future planning in case of ramp ups etc.
  + Resource Allocation & Retention
    - Conduct effective resource planning to maximize the productivity of resources (people, technology etc.)
    - Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
    - Optimize manpower and minimize leakages by working closely with delivery head
    - Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
    - Lead one-on-one floor connect and other engagement activities to improve stickiness of the delivery team
    - Collaborate and influence internal key stakeholders to manage and resolve issues to ensure fulfillment and flawless delivery of projects

Mandatory Skills: Investment Banking(Loans)
  
.

Experience: >10 YEARS
  
.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Salesforce Technical manager
description:
**Position ::**
Salesforce Technical Project Manager

**Experience:**
10+ Years

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Project Manager to manage end-to-end Salesforce projects. The candidate will work closely with business teams, developers, architects, and QA teams to ensure successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate should have strong Salesforce technical knowledge, project management experience, and exposure to the Telecom domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Salesforce projects from planning to implementation and post-production support.
* Coordinate with developers, architects, business analysts, QA teams, and other stakeholders.
* Manage project timelines, resources, risks, and deliverables.
* Understand business requirements and convert them into technical requirements and user stories.
* Oversee Salesforce integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment activities.
* Manage sprint planning, daily scrum meetings, and project progress using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Coordinate UAT, resolve project issues, and ensure smooth production releases.
* Work with DevOps tools such as Jira, Confluence, Git, Copado, or Azure DevOps.
* Communicate project updates, risks, and solutions to senior management.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in IT or software engineering.
* 3–5+ years of experience managing Salesforce projects and implementations.
* Experience in the Telecom domain is required, preferably with large telecom companies.
* Good knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, and Revenue Cloud.
* Understanding of Salesforce architecture, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), security, and permissions.
* Experience managing system integrations and data migration projects.
* Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, UAT, release management, and project delivery.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or CPQ.
* PMP, CSM, PMI-ACP, or SAFe certification.
* Exposure to Experience Cloud, Agentforce, or CRM Analytics.

title: Manager - NetSuite EPM
description:
Riveron is looking for a Solution Architect focused on Oracle / NetSuite Planning and Budgeting (PBCS / NSPB) software to join our Technology Enablement practice. This client-facing role will interact with key client leadership (CFO, Controller etc.) and will contribute to the areas of business development and sales, practice development, and project execution and quality assurance on the Oracle / NetSuite Planning and Budgeting engagements.
  
  
The Solution Architect will work side-by-side with our implementation team members in leading multiple client projects ranging from software selection, implementations or optimizations, integrations, and technical support. The successful candidate must demonstrate a proven implementation background and the willingness to serve as a leader through business development and sales as well as practice development.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Support Business Development and Sales

+ Participate in and lead pre-sales meetings with current and prospective clients to assess project level-of-effort and to assist in determining if Oracle / NetSuite Planning and Budgeting are the best fit for requirements presented.
+ Work with Engagement Management to determine the timeline, resource plan, level-of-effort and fee estimates required for implementation in achieving client objectives.
+ Create and review work plans and draft proposals for completeness.

* Execute Projects

+ Collaborate with Riveron team members to develop efficient and high-quality EPM solutions
+ Participate in workshops to define implementation strategy
+ Lead and conduct all aspects of our implementation methodologies
+ Apply leading practices to solution design and build to adhere to client requirements
+ Configure the Oracle and NetSuite Planning and Budgeting (NSPB/PBCS) software to develop and present sustainable solutions to client executives and key stakeholders
+ Mentor and education client personnel and consulting team members

* Oracle/NetSuite EPM Practice Development

+ Work with practice leadership to develop and deliver EPM-specific training, business development training and collateral and engagement materials/templates.

**Who You Are**

* Ability to develop, grow and sustain client relationships
* Ability to guide, develop and grow team members
* Team oriented personality
* Entrepreneurial spirit and a solution-oriented mindset
* Ability to work in ever-changing, dynamic environments
* Ability to craft and deliver verbal, written, and oral messages and make recommendations to a variety of audiences, including client leadership and internal teams
* Desire to get involved in the Riveron culture and internal initiatives, including community service, training, interviewing, intramurals, and other social/networking activities

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Accounting, Finance, or Management Information Systems (MIS)
* 7+ years of experience with Oracle EPM solutions, including at least 4+ years in Oracle PBCS / NSPB.
* Oracle /NetSuite EPM Planning (especially pre-built models of Financial Planning and Workforce Planning) solution architecture.
* Strong expertise in Essbase: cube design (ASO/BSO), calculation scripts, and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with Calculation Manager, Smart View, Data Management (FDMEE), and EPM Automate.
* Proven experience integrating Oracle/NetSuite ERP with EPM via Saved Searches and data pipelines.
* Strong understanding of FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, CapEx, Opex, workforce planning).
* Ability to lead workshops, gather requirements, and deliver business-facing solutions.
* Strong communication skills to engage both technical and business stakeholders.

**­­­­­­­­­­­**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle EPM Cloud and/or Essbase certification.
* Experience with Financial Consolidation & Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS with Transaction matching) and Hyperion Financial Management (HFM), OneStream, Adaptive or Anaplan
* Familiarity with BI/reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, Oracle Analytics Cloud).
* Advanced integration skills: REST APIs, scripting, or middleware (Dell Boomi, MuleSoft).
* Prior consulting experience in large-scale EPM/ERP transformation projects.

**About Riveron**
At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.
  
  
Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Salesforce Architect Manager
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Technical Architect & Salesforce Manager**
to join our consulting team. In this hybrid role, you will act as a
**billable Technical Architect**
on active client engagements—designing robust, scalable Salesforce solutions—while simultaneously
**managing and mentoring a team**
of skilled Salesforce Developers to ensure technical excellence, professional growth, and successful project delivery.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills from a technology perspective, including a foundational understanding of how to leverage AI development tools to optimize delivery cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background. You are able to lead and motivate a team of highly capable individuals and help them meet their targets while enabling their growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Requirements**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, guiding delivery teams on the effective use of AI-assisted tooling to maintain velocity and quality
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, encouraging the use of AI coding assistants to enforce best practices
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Ability to understand a project and debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to assist in interpreting logs and isolating bottlenecks
* From time-to-time, participate in activities such as technical landscape discovery, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Commerce Clouds, with a foundational familiarity with Salesforce's AI offerings (e.g., Agentforce)
* Understanding of systems architecture
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Lead a technical team and own customer and team engagement
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%
* Maintain a target billable utilisation aligned to the role
* 9-15 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Maintain billable utilisation targets for your team
* Technical enablement of team members on the latest Salesforce products and processes, including upskilling on modern AI development tools and practices
* Working with global teams for delivery across geographies. We will need you to be flexible with your work hours

title: Sourcing (Real estate)

**About SAA: Our Legacy of Trust and Success**

For more than
**27+ years**
, Sunil Agrawal & Associates has been a leading name in Central India's real estate market. We've built our reputation on unwavering integrity and a commitment to ethical practices. Sales

The ideal candidate will be responsible for expanding channel partnerships, generating quality leads, driving site visits and bookings, and supporting the overall sales strategy through effective relationship management.

* Embody the Group's values and global standards in every aspect of how you operate as a banking professional.

* Ensure departmental compliance with IATF 16949 and other quality systems.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

description:

We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.**
The Business Process Owner (BPO) - Salesforce is responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving customer relationship management processes across Mobility through the Salesforce platform. The role serves as the primary business owner for CRM-enabled processes spanning Sales, Service, Warranty, and Customer Management, ensuring alignment between business objectives, process standards, data requirements, and technology capabilities.
  
  
This position acts as a strategic liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams, translating business needs into scalable digital solutions and ensuring successful deployment, adoption, and value realization of Salesforce capabilities. Coordinate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements and expected outcomes.
  
  
Drive successful deployment and adoption of Salesforce capabilities across Mobility business units.

Establish and govern CRM-related KPIs, performance measures, and adoption metrics to monitor business value realization.

Monitor CRM utilization, process effectiveness, user feedback, and enhancement opportunities to drive continuous improvement.

title: AVP/ Account Transitions Lead
description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Summary**
Account Transitions provide a high level of support for the take on and ongoing service of AB Institutional clients as well as Private Clients with DvP mandates. The individual will be responsible for managing a Team that project manage these activities from an OP’s perspective.
  
  
The key objective is to achieve internal and external client satisfaction during any ‘transition’ event lifecycle – be that an a/c opening, closing or BaU event.
  
  
The role necessitates constant emphasis on attention to detail and adherence to deadlines but also requires an ability to ensure prompt and appropriate response to a broad range of enquiries from internal and external clients. An understanding of the implications of a global model is extremely important, as our accounting systems are at the heart of our systems infrastructure and the impact of any change to data or flow can be fundamental.
  
  
**Responsibilities/Prime Functions**

* Work closely with internal stakeholders to manage fund/mandate launches, closures, and transition events (Custodian Changes, Name changes, In Specie Transitions, Benchmark Changes)
* Project Manage the end-to-end process and mitigate risks associated with fund/mandate launches, closures, and transition events
* Manage communication with external parties e.g. custodians, administrators, transition managers and in some instances the underlying client throughout the life cycle of the event
* Manage communication internally and externally during events to ensure all stakeholders are aware of progress and are contributing towards the target completion dates
* Maintain awareness of internal team’s processes and controls as well as the changing regulatory environment
* Foster and maintain strong working relationships with other functional areas of the business as required
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external service and system providers
* Manage the operational set up of each transition event on internal systems and establish custodial accounts and linkage
* Ensure that market openings for new clients are completed in advance of funding date and new market requests are completed on a timely basis for existing clients
* Co-ordinate the review and approval of Operating Memorandum Reviews and Operational SLA’s (legally contractual documents outlining the services the asset manager commits to provide to client and or their administrator).
* Work Closely with the Derivatives Administration team to facilitate the set-up of Trading Agreements for trading of derivatives
* Adhere to SLA’s as defined within the Client Servicing procedures.

**Secondary Functions**

* Participation with respect to the completion of specifically allocated tasks within the scope of department projects and initiatives.
* Ongoing review of current systems, procedures and processes, making recommendations for improvement, where required.
* Participate in Operational Risk initiatives as required.

**Skills / Experience Required**

* Candidates will have a degree or alternatively minimum A Level standard of education with a solid track record in Transitions and client relationship management to be considered.
* Relevant industry professional qualifications (such as the IMC or IAQ’s) are desirable, but not essential.
* Minimum 2 years dedicated Client Servicing / Account Transition / OP’s experience
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Strong industry knowledge regarding Operations Middle and Back Office functions; Settlements, Confirmations, Reconciliation, Client Reporting, Performance, Pricing & valuation, Corporate Actions, Client Guideline Management.
* Experience of financial systems, e.g. SWIFT, TLM, Bloomberg, custodian proprietary systems, Portfolio Accounting Systems (e.g. HiPortfolio, Portia, etc).
* Competent user of MS Office suite.
* Strong experience of manual and automated reconciliations.
* Strong knowledge of Investment Product Classes; Equity, Fixed Income, Forwards, Derivatives, Alternatives
* Strong knowledge of Trading and Investment principles.
* Experience in liaising with brokers, custodians and fund accountants.
* Flexible approach to a multi-tasking work environment.
* Demonstrates an ability to work with minimal supervision, as well as within a team environment
* Demonstrates an ability to identify and evaluate potential risks, and escalate items appropriately.

description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**IAM Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and maintain the multi-year IAM product strategy and modernization roadmap.
* Establish target-state capabilities for workforce IAM, client IAM, privileged access, authorization, machine identities, and identity intelligence.
* Partner with cybersecurity leadership to align IAM capabilities with regulatory requirements, risk management objectives, and business priorities.

* Create business cases, investment proposals, and strategic recommendations for IAM modernization initiatives.

**Product Ownership & Capability Management**

* Serve as the product owner for one or more strategic IAM platforms and services.
* Define product vision, objectives, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
* Translate business, regulatory, security, and operational requirements into executable product capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure successful delivery of roadmap commitments.
* Define adoption targets, value realization metrics, and product success criteria.

**Automation & Engineering Enablement**

* Lead the IAM automation strategy across identity lifecycle management, access governance, certification, auditing, privileged access, authorization, and security operations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual processing through workflow automation, orchestration, self-service capabilities, and intelligent controls.
* Drive adoption of automation platforms, governance workflows, and low-code/no-code orchestration capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to streamline onboarding, access requests, certifications, JML processes, and control execution.
* Develop automation strategies supporting workforce, client, machine, and AI-driven identities.
* Leverage tools such as Tines, Copilot, and AI Agents to improve operational efficiency and user experience.
* Create resilient, always-on automation capabilities to provide near 24x7 operational support and increase team productivity.

**Identity Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Establish measurable KPIs, KCIs, and KRIs for IAM products and services.
* Drive continual improvement of operational processes and user experience.
* Partner with operations teams to improve service reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
* Develop reporting, dashboards, and executive reporting packages.
* Ensure IAM capabilities maintain strong control effectiveness and audit readiness.

**Strategic Programs & Transformation**

* Lead automation of strategic modernization initiatives involving:

+ Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
+ Privileged Access Management (PAM)
+ Authentication Modernization
+ Authorization Modernization
+ Role Based Access Control (RBAC)
+ Fine-Grained Authorization
+ Machine Identity Governance
+ Agent and AI Identity Governance
+ SaaS Security Integration
+ Identity Intelligence & Risk Analytics

* Coordinate across engineering, architecture, risk, cybersecurity, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.

**Governance, Risk & Regulatory Alignment**

* Ensure IAM products align with enterprise standards, policies, and regulatory expectations.
* Support audits, examinations, and control reviews.
* Partner with Risk, Audit, Architecture, and Security organizations to define and maintain control requirements.
* Translate regulatory requirements into roadmap priorities and product capabilities.
* Maintain accountability for delivery of risk-reducing capabilities and control improvements.

**Areas of Accountability**

* IAM Product Portfolio Management
* IAM Strategy & Roadmaps
* Identity Governance Platforms
* Privileged Access Platforms
* Authentication & Authorization Products
* IAM Automation & Workflow Orchestration
* RBAC & Access Governance
* Identity Analytics & Reporting
* Machine Identity Governance
* AI & Agent Identity Governance
* IAM Metrics, KPIs, KCIs & KRIs
* Regulatory & Audit Readiness
* Continuous Improvement Programs

**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, Product Management, Security Engineering, or related technology disciplines.
* 3+ years leading strategic technology initiatives, product portfolios, or transformation programs.
* Experience with IAM platforms such as Saviynt, Okta, Entra ID, CyberArk, SailPoint, Ping, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of IAM disciplines including:

+ Authentication
+ Authorization
+ Identity Governance
+ Access Lifecycle Management
+ RBAC
+ OAuth/OIDC
+ SAML
+ MFA
+ PAM
+ Machine Identities

* Experience with automation and workflow platforms.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including NIST, FFIEC, ISO 27001, NYDFS, and related financial services requirements.

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of IAM strategic roadmap objectives.
* Increased automation and reduction of manual IAM processes.
* Improved control effectiveness and regulatory readiness.
* Reduced operational risk and technical debt.
* Enhanced user and administrator experience.
* Increased adoption of IAM automation solutions, AI agents, Copilot use cases, and workflow platforms such as Tines.
* Increased operational resiliency through near 24x7 automated IAM capabilities.
* Quantifiable improvements in IAM KPIs, KCIs, and KRIs.
* Establishment of a scalable and sustainable identity control plane supporting workforce, client, machine, and AI identities.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Property Yatra LLP is inspired by the long-term value of strategic real estate investment, focusing on opportunities in and around growing urban areas. The organization believes in acquiring property where future development and demand are expected to rise, and in holding those assets to realize sustainable returns. Property Yatra LLP aims to guide clients through informed real estate decisions, aligning purchases with market timing and growth potential. The company values patience, insight, and a data-driven approach to real estate, offering clients trusted advisory services for building long-term wealth.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Relationship Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division, responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of real estate clients. The role involves building strong, long-term relationships with buyers, investors, and partners, understanding their requirements, and advising them on suitable properties and investment opportunities. Day-to-day tasks include conducting client meetings and site visits, coordinating with internal sales and operations teams, and ensuring timely communication throughout the transaction process. The Senior Relationship Manager will track client interactions, maintain accurate records, and proactively follow up to support closures and repeat business. The role also includes monitoring market trends in the Pune region, contributing to business development initiatives, and representing Property Yatra LLP at events and client engagements.

Engagement & client leadership -***

* Lead multiple technology engagements simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery across the lifecycle — discovery, requirements, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing operations.
* Build and manage client relationships across assigned accounts, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for technology initiatives and strategic discussions.

* Act as the OT subject-matter expert — shape and drive manufacturing and Industry 4.0 use cases across sites and enterprise programs (process monitoring, predictive maintenance, OEE, yield, energy, asset reliability).
* Apply deep knowledge of plant-floor OT and industrial data: sensors and instrumentation, PLC / DCS / SCADA, historians (e.g. OSIsoft / AVEVA PI), industrial IoT and edge, and manufacturing data platforms.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements and workstreams concurrently while balancing client expectations, delivery commitments and business priorities.
* Ability to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions and guide initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment across multiple locations (India and US).
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to communicate with executive stakeholders; fluency in English.
* Client-first mentality, intense work ethic, collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach.
* Deep OT / industrial data expertise: sensors, PLC/DCS/SCADA, historians (PI), IIoT/edge, Unified Namespace, ontology / semantic models; ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA, MQTT.
* Strong technology background: solution architecture, data engineering, Python / SQL, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP) and integration.
* Life-sciences / pharma manufacturing domain experience.

**Nice to have :**

* Exposure to Smart Factory, Connected Worker, Digital Twin and Industrial AI initiatives.
* Familiarity with cloud industrial data platforms (e.g. Cognite, Snowflake) and streaming (Kafka); OT cybersecurity and data governance.
* Broad exposure across multiple technology domains — enterprise applications, cloud, analytics, data platforms or digital products.
* Demonstrated success identifying, shaping and expanding opportunities within existing client accounts.

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities

title: Donor Relations Manager
description:
**About the organization:**

Bharatiya Jain Sanghatana is a non-profit organisation dedicated to nation-building through impactful social development, disaster response, environmental stewardship, and educational initiatives since 1985. With a strong nationwide presence and an active volunteer network, BJS works collaboratively with governments, communities and partners to design and implement sustainable solutions to pressing societal challenges. The organization’s mission is to identify relevant social concerns, develop meaningful interventions and ensure their effective, scalable implementation across the country.

**Position Overview:**

The Manager – Donor Relations Management will play a crucial role in strengthening and expanding strategic partnerships with corporates, CSR foundations, philanthropic institutions and other relevant stakeholders to support BJS’ mission and programmes. The role combines strategic engagement, relationship management, proposal development, impact communication and effective coordination across functions to drive resource mobilization and deepen partner engagement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

a) Partnership Strategy & Outreach:

 Research, identify and engage potential partners whose priorities align with BJS’ mission, programmes and impact goals.

 Support development of tailored engagement strategies for prospective donors.

 Assist in developing high-quality concept notes, proposals, partnership decks and budgets for effective donor engagement.

(b) Donor Engagement & Relationship Management:

 Build and nurture long-term relationships with existing and prospective donor partners.

 Coordinate meetings, presentations and follow-up conversations with all stakeholders to progress partnership engagements.

 Work with programme teams to capture impact data, success stories and case studies for donor engagement and reporting purposes.

 Support programme teams in developing proposals, concept notes, and strategic project documentation.

(c) Donor Reporting & Compliance:

 Prepare high-quality, timely and accurate donor reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) as per agreed formats and timelines with various donor partners.

 Coordinate with programme and finance teams to collect utilization data, impact metrics and supporting documentation.

 Ensure compliance with donor agreements, MoUs and CSR reporting requirements.

 Closely track grant milestones, deliverables and utilisation schedules to avoid delays and non-compliance.

 Maintain complete documentation of agreements, amendments, invoices and reporting records related to all donor/partner engagements.

(d) Donor Database & Systems Management:

 Maintain and regularly update donor databases, CRM systems, and grant trackers.

 Monitor key donor timelines, renewal cycles and reporting calendars.

 Develop structured trackers for grant utilization and partnership commitments.

(e) Partner and Stakeholder Engagement:

 Serve as a bridge between partners, programme and finance teams to ensure execution of donor commitments.

 Support the leadership/management with data, summaries and briefing notes for various donor engagements.

 Assist in developing donor engagement SOPs and internal reporting systems.

Qualifications and Experience:

 Master’s degree in development studies, Social Work, Management, or a related field.

 Minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in donor management, CSR partnerships, grant management or institutional fundraising within the social development/non-profit sector.

 Understanding of CSR compliance frameworks and grant management processes.

Key Skills and Competencies:

 Excellent verbal and written communication abilities in English and Hindi. Working knowledge of Marathi a plus.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (for grant tracking, utilisation analysis) and PowerPoint (for donor presentations).

 Ability to manage multiple donor accounts simultaneously with structured planning.

 High level of integrity, empathy, and alignment with service-oriented values.

 Ability to work sensitively within a mission-driven, values-based organization. Personal Attributes:

 Deep commitment and passion for social impact.

 High sense of ownership and accountability.

 Proactive, organized and deadline conscious.

 Relationship-oriented with strong interpersonal skills.

**Interested can share their resume on psaini@bjsindia.org**

title: Account Management Specialist - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for managing customer relationships and account strategies for less complex accounts, including regional, single-business-unit, or internal accounts. The role may also support larger and more complex accounts in partnership with senior account management leaders.
  
  
The position is responsible for driving sales of Cummins products and services to assigned business customers, expanding existing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and executing account plans aligned with business strategy and revenue objectives. The role acts as a key customer interface and advocate for the voice of the customer within Cummins.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, manage, and maintain strong business relationships with assigned accounts in alignment with the organization's sales strategy.
* Develop and execute account strategies and sales plans to achieve revenue, growth, customer satisfaction, and business objectives.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities and support initiatives that contribute to revenue growth and cost reduction.
* Expand sales of Cummins products and services within existing customer accounts by understanding customer requirements and identifying opportunities for growth.
* Lead and coordinate customer communication and interfaces at appropriate stakeholder levels.
* Negotiate and implement customer contracts within established authorization and business guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address production, distribution, service, inventory, and delivery requirements associated with assigned accounts.
* Act as a champion for the voice of the customer and ensure customer needs and feedback are effectively represented within the business.
* Measure customer satisfaction, identify improvement areas, and develop action plans to strengthen the customer experience.
* Support and drive account strategy execution by collaborating with key stakeholders across functions and business units.
* Drive cross-business-unit account development initiatives in support of broader account strategies.
* Lead Customer Focus Six Sigma initiatives and other improvement activities aimed at strengthening customer relationships and business performance.
* Manage accounts receivable deliverables, including discussions and negotiations related to payment terms, as applicable.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and track performance, progress, and forecast accuracy against business targets.
* Monitor account performance, relationship strength, product competitiveness, quality, service, and other key factors to identify risks and opportunities.
* Balance customer requirements with business capabilities related to inventory, service, and delivery, in collaboration with internal stakeholders and customers.
* Use customer and market insights to support account planning, pipeline development, and long-term business growth.

**Key Competencies**
**Customer & Relationship Management**

* Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions.
* Communicates Effectively: Tailors communication across different audiences and stakeholder levels to convey complex information clearly.
* Integrates Customer Perspective: Uses customer insights to improve sales effectiveness, customer experience, and revenue growth.
* Instills Trust: Builds credibility through honesty, integrity, transparency, and authentic interactions.
* Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives and experiences.

**Commercial & Account Management**

* Account Planning: Defines objectives, monitors progress, and drives execution against account and business targets.
* Developing Account Strategy: Evaluates account relationships, financial performance, product competitiveness, quality, service, barriers, customer requirements, and business capabilities to define achievable account strategies.
* Articulates Value Proposition: Understands customer requirements and effectively communicates the value of Cummins products, solutions, and services against customer needs and competitive alternatives.
* Pricing Strategy: Develops and supports pricing approaches by building alignment with relevant stakeholders to achieve business objectives.
* Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, and routes to market to support business growth.

**Sales & Business Development**

* Sales Forecasting: Analyzes internal and external customer data and historical trends to support accurate sales forecasts and future consumption planning.
* Sales Pipeline Management: Monitors pipeline health, prioritizes opportunities, identifies gaps, and supports actions required to achieve sales objectives.
* Sense Making: Uses research, probing, and analysis to understand customer needs, buying behavior, and business drivers and translates insights into relevant solutions and actions.
* Adapts to Target Audience: Communicates technical, commercial, and business information appropriately for different audiences.

**Leadership & Execution**

* Ensures Accountability: Takes ownership of commitments and follows through on deliverables and agreed actions.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic customer-facing environment.
* Strong commercial judgment and problem-solving capability.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, Engineering, a technical discipline, or a related field .
* Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.
* Licensing or other compliance requirements may apply depending on applicable export control and sanctions regulations.

**Skills & Experience**

* Significant relevant experience in account management, sales, business development, customer management, or a related commercial function .
* Previous customer-facing and/or product-related experience is required.
* Strong understanding of account management, sales strategy, customer relationship management, and business development.
* Experience in identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.
* Strong negotiation, commercial, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with purchasing and/or commercial contract negotiation is preferred.
* Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and customer satisfaction initiatives is preferred.
* Ability to analyze customer, market, and business data and convert insights into actionable account strategies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across business units and functions to deliver customer and business outcomes.
* Strong customer orientation with the ability to balance customer expectations and business requirements.

**Role-Specific Additional Competencies / Requirements**

* Railways & Parts Business Experience Prior experience in handling Railways Segment customers , preferably with good exposure to Parts sales through both Direct and Channel routes . Working knowledge of IREPS portal, Railway tenders, bidding processes, customer requirements and associated commercial processes will be an added advantage.
* Tender Data Analytics & Market Insights Strong analytical skills to regularly monitor and analyse Railway tender data, identify trends, competition, business opportunities and gaps, and convert the analysis into actionable business insights for the team.
* Sales Initiative & Execution Management Ability to drive Parts sales initiatives end-to-end , establish clear action plans and milestones, monitor progress through appropriate metrics, and ensure timely execution and closure to deliver the desired business outcomes.
* Institutional Team Level Activity - Presentation Deck & Initiative collationGood presentation and communication skills, with the ability to consolidate business insights, progress and key issues into effective management presentations. Should also be capable of collating and reporting initiatives at the Institutional Team level after interacting with all the Segment Leaders / teams (as and when needed), ensuring visibility, accountability and timely follow-up.

title: Case Escalation Manager
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
  
  
We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
  
  
**Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?**
The position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation management for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Cohesity business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers. These issues typically have executive transparency and involve issues that span product, service, support and other business functions within Cohesity.
  
  
The role requires both cross-functional as well as external coordination with customers and partners, Sustaining and Development Engineers, Product Management, Site Reliability Engineers, and Account Teams in unison to resolve complex challenges. In this role, you will lead and manage the programmatic resolution of customers' critical issues by building and owning an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically-located virtual team.

:
  
  

* Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customer’s critical issues

* Maintain and expand a solid understanding of current Cohesity products and their business applications
* Participate in weekly escalation review meetings between Sales, Customer Support, Product Management, and Engineering
* The escalation manager is an individual contributor role that reports to the program director and works seamlessly with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support, Professional Services and customer-facing teams to address and prevent critical issues

**WE'D LOVE TO TALK IF YOU HAVE ANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**

* Capacity to work in a challenging environment with international clients
* Written and verbal communication skills; including the ability to clearly articulate technical issues to executive audiences as well technical and also explain the impact in business terms
* Strong analytical and end to end problem-solving skills
* Solid Technical Knowledge, ability to articulate technical concepts clearly, good understanding of Data Center, Storage, Networking, Virtualization technologies.
* Capability to multitask and prioritize with a strong sense of getting to closure on behalf of the customer
* Be comfortable in a fast-paced, demanding environment with global customers
* Have an excellent customer-first demeanor and willingness to go beyond expectations to ensure customer success
* Demonstrated proficiencies to lead and motivate others through forming and executing resolution plans for complex issues
* 2+ years of Escalation Management experience - Account escalation experience required, and proven experience in managing Critical Customer situations.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and support high-quality decision-making.

* Negotiate balanced, sustainable agreements

The position serves as the primary strategic interface between Kelvion and Google across Commercial, Execution and Technology functions for the region.
  
  
**Key Tasks & Responsibilities**

* Work with other Regional Account Managers for Google (Americas, EMEA, APAC)

* Own the commercial roadmap across key product categories (e.g. indoor cooling, heat rejection, modular infrastructure)
* Position Kelvion as a preferred supplier within Google’s regional ecosystem

**Commercial Strategy & Margin Protection (Critical Priority)**

* Develop and apply cost models and TCO frameworks to support value-based selling
* Ensure growth is delivered without compromising margin

* Engage ecosystem partners (EPCs, integrators, contractors) supporting delivery

* Participate in commercial negotiations, contract frameworks, and RFQ/RFP processes
* Drive value-based commercial positioning in large-scale programmes
* Ensure consistency and governance across the region and deal structures

**Demand Planning, Capacity & Risk Management**

* Align supply chain and production capacity with Google’s regional project pipeline
* Negotiate risk-sharing mechanisms, including:

+ Forecasting commitments
+ Co-investment in capacity
+ Demand stability measures

* Protect continuity of supply while managing volatility

**Innovation & Value Co-Creation**

* Champion joint innovation initiatives with Google engineering teams
* Structure co-development agreements with:

+ Shared IP
+ Cost and reward sharing models

* Strengthen Kelvion’s position as a long-term strategic partner

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate a regional account team (sales, engineering, operations, supply chain)
* Translate customer requirements into internal solutions and execution plans
* Exercise broad decision-making authority within defined commercial limits
* Engage senior leadership when required to deliver account objectives

**Governance & Escalation**

* Participate in formal governance processes, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)
* Participate in executive-level engagement on both sides
* Act as the primary escalation point to resolve issues quickly and effectively within the region

**Performance Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor and reportperformance across:

+ Revenue growth
+ Margin delivery
+ Project execution

* Drive improvements in delivery, responsiveness, and quality
* Benchmark competitors and strengthen competitive positioning

**Key Deliverables**

* Sustained revenue growth and order intake across the regional Google programmes
* Strong margin discipline and profitability improvement
* Increased win rate on strategic data centre projects
* Achievement of preferred / approved supplier status
* High levels of customer satisfaction and relationship strength

**Additional Competencies / Local Requirements**

* Significant experience in complex, solution-led sales environments
* Track record of sustained profitable growth
* Experience working with high-performing teams (direct or matrix)
* Strong collaboration and continuous improvement mindset within the three regions
* Industry knowledge in data centres and cooling solutions
* Background in heat exchangers or engineered solutions (advantageous)
* Solid understanding of the data centre and cooling solutions landscape, including customer drivers, technical requirements and market dynamics.
* Experience within the heat exchanger or engineered solutions industry is advantageous, but not essential.

* Proven background in strategic sales, account management, or key account management
* Experience in data centres, HVAC, cooling, or capital equipment environments
* Demonstrated success managing global customers, EPCs, and contractors
* Strong commercial negotiation and contract management expertise

* Strategic thinking with strong commercial acumen
* Ability to operate effectively in complex global matrix organisations
* Data-driven decision-making and forecasting capability
* Technical understanding of cooling or infrastructure solutions
* Degree in Engineering, Business, or related field (MBA advantageous)

**What Kelvion Offers**

* Opportunity to shape strategy, not just execute

* Commitment to inclusion, development, and long-term career growth

* **Communication & Stakeholder Management:**

* **Problem-Solving & Decision-Making:**
  Ability to resolve complex operational challenges, prioritize effectively, and make timely decisions.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Experience identifying operational gaps and implementing measurable improvements.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Ability to work effectively with technical, product, implementation, and business teams.
* **Ownership & Accountability:**
  Strong results orientation with responsibility for regional performance and customer outcomes.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with CRM, customer support, ticketing, or workflow management platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled support tools, automation, and digital productivity solutions.
* Experience managing enterprise customers or technology-enabled service operations.
* Experience leading customer enablement, product adoption, or customer engagement programs.

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Pune Factory

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
**Job Description**
The purpose of having a project manager is to coordinate all project activities from initiation to completion, ensuring that objectives are achieved on time, within scope, and budget. They serve as a liaison between stakeholders and team members, facilitating effective communication and managing expectations. Project managers efficiently allocate resources, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. By maintaining documentation and reporting on progress, they provide visibility into the project's status and foster a culture of continuous improvement for future projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Project Planning: Develop a detailed project plan outlining objectives, scope, resources, timeline, and budget.
* Team Leadership: Lead and manage the project team, ensuring effective collaboration and communication among team members.
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, equipment, and materials.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and addressing concerns.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project success.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure that project deliverables meet predefined quality standards and requirements.
* Monitoring & Reporting: Track project progress through key performance indicators and prepare regular status reports for stakeholders.
* Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring expenditures stay within limits and financial resources are used appropriately.
* Problem Solving: Address challenges and obstacles that arise during the project lifecycle to keep the project on track.
* Closing the Project: Conduct project closure activities, including final deliverable acceptance, documentation, and team debriefing.

**Skills Required**

* Leadership: Ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve project goals.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information to various stakeholders.
* Time Management: Skill in managing one’s own time and the time of others to meet deadlines.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Problem-Solving: Proficiency in analyzing problems, generating solutions, and making decisions quickly.
* Negotiation: Skill in negotiating resources, contracts, and stakeholder needs to achieve project objectives.
* Technical Knowledge: Understanding of the specific industry or technical aspects relevant to the project.
* Budgeting: Ability to create and manage budgets effectively to keep projects on track financially.
* Organizational Skills: Strong organizational abilities to juggle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Adaptability: Capacity to adjust to changing circumstances and respond to unforeseen challenges.

**Key Success Factors (Key Metrics / KPIs / Deliverables)**

* Driving sales for break through Initiatives (BTI), Core Growth Initiatives (CGI)
* Demand Generation
* Drive lock-in specifications and dilute challenging specs
* Drive regulatory approval and customer AVL
* OEM development by application selling. - infrastructure, F&B, Power, Heat treatment, Packaging, OEMs
* Identifying gaps in the current coverage and drive Honeywell acceptance
* Participate in Mutual Action Planning (MAP) discussions with our CP/SI
* Attend Pre-bid and post bid technical meetings and drive Honeywell needs
* Willing to travel 5 days in a month to SEA countries
* Improve the project margin 2% to 5% from booking.
* Control the project resources within the budget
* Revenue Recognition as per the project schedule
* Good or Improve customer experience based on customer feedback (survey)

**Qualifications**
**Work Experience Required**

* 8-10 years with at least 4 years in on HON or competitors FI product portfolio
* Proven business experience in multiple vertical markets, including field products industries. Networking within the instrumentation industry- large customers, OEM's, EPC's and Consultants will be a strong advantage.
* Supporting sales campaigns or programs in specific markets or for specific products
* Proven Presentation skills

**Specific Knowledge Required**

* Technical understanding of portfolio, competition and understanding of customer applications is must

* Understands the value proposition of Honeywell and all the company has to offer
* From experience, a good knowledge of our customers’ businesses and drivers

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world.
