title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.

**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.

As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:

* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.

title: Manager / Sr Manager – Engine Application, Technical Solutions & BD
description:
**Job Description:**

Manager / Senior Manager – Engine Application, Technical Solutions & Business Development

Location: Pune | Reporting To: Business Head / Head – Engine Business

SUMMARY

To lead the Engine Application business by understanding customer equipment requirements, recommending suitable engine solutions, and providing technical support throughout the sales, integration, and commissioning lifecycle. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end business management, including customer acquisition, account management, revenue generation, profitability, collections, and customer service while acting as the technical expert for engine application engineering and business growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Application Engineering & Engine Selection**

Study customer machine/equipment specifications and operating conditions.

Recommend suitable diesel, gas, or alternate fuel engines based on power, torque, duty cycle, emissions, and performance requirements.

Perform engine sizing, load analysis, and application feasibility assessments.

Ensure proper engine-machine compatibility and integration.

**Customer Engagement & Technical Consulting**

Interact with OEMs, machine manufacturers, industrial customers, consultants, and EPC contractors.

Understand customer requirements and provide technically optimized solutions.

Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations, and solution discussions.

Support customers during design, installation, testing, commissioning, and after-sales support stages.

**Business Development & Sales Management**

Drive revenue growth from engine application and technical solutions business.

Identify, develop, and onboard new customers, OEMs, and business partners.

Generate enquiries and convert opportunities into confirmed orders.

Develop and manage key customer relationships to ensure long-term business growth.

Support preparation of techno-commercial proposals, bids, and business presentations.

Achieve annual sales, revenue, and profitability targets.

**P&L Ownership & Commercial Management**

Manage the Profit & Loss (P&L) for the assigned business segment.

Monitor revenue, margins, profitability, and business performance.

Ensure effective pricing, commercial negotiations, and contract management.

Drive cost optimization initiatives while maintaining customer satisfaction.

**Customer Service & Account Management**

Own end-to-end customer lifecycle management from enquiry to payment realization.

Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat business.

Address customer concerns and coordinate internal teams for timely resolution.

Develop customer engagement plans and strengthen strategic account relationships.

**Debtors, Collections & Payment Recovery**

Monitor customer outstanding balances and ageing reports.

Ensure timely collection of payments and recovery of overdue receivables.

Coordinate with finance and customers to resolve payment-related issues.

Maintain healthy debtor levels and optimize working capital.

**OEM & Supplier Coordination**

Liaise with engine manufacturers and technology partners for product selection and customization.

Coordinate with suppliers and engineering teams for application-specific requirements.

Support development of new products and customized solutions.

**Project Execution & Field Support**

Support installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance validation activities.

Conduct site visits and application audits.

Resolve application-related issues and provide corrective recommendations.

**Product & Market Development**

Track market trends, customer requirements, and competitor offerings.

Identify opportunities for introducing new engine technologies and solutions.

Support product positioning and market expansion initiatives.

**Documentation & Compliance**

Prepare technical specifications, application notes, and customer documentation.

Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards and emission norms.

Maintain application records, customer database, and technical reports.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

Revenue and profitability achieved from Engine Application Business

P&L performance against budget

New customer acquisition and market development

Proposal-to-order conversion ratio

Customer retention and satisfaction levels

Debtor ageing and collection efficiency

Timely payment recovery and working capital management

Number of successful engine application projects executed

Timely resolution of customer and technical issues

Reduction in field failures and application-related complaints

title: Customer Success Engineer (SaaS) | Pune Onsite
description:
**About BotSpace**

BotSpace builds AI agents for e-commerce brands. They help brands sell more and handle customer support across their website, WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels. We work with fast-growing D2C and Shopify brands and are building an AI-native platform for sales, support and customer engagement.

**The role**

This is a customer role for an engineer. You'll own a group of BotSpace customers from the day they sign: get them live, learn how their business runs, find what stops them getting value from BotSpace and solve it. Sometimes that's configuration. Sometimes it's a script or an integration with the rest of their stack. Sometimes it's a bug you've narrowed down so well that our engineers can fix it the same day.

Elsewhere this job is called a forward-deployed engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager. It isn't a pure development role: most of your week is spent with customers, and the code you write is in service of them.

**What you'll do**

* Onboard new brands: WhatsApp Business API setup, Meta verification and message templates, Shopify and other integrations, their first automations and their AI agent
* Own the relationship with your accounts on calls, WhatsApp and email, and review with them regularly what's working and what isn't
* Debug customer issues end to end: read the logs, check API responses and webhooks, reproduce the problem, then fix it or give engineering a bug report they can act on
* Build what a customer needs on top of the product: API and webhook integrations, small scripts, data imports, custom flows
* Notice early when an account is at risk, and when one is ready to do more with us
* Bring patterns back to the product team: repeat issues, missing features, rough edges in onboarding
* Write the docs and playbooks that help the next customer go live faster

**What we're looking for**

* A software engineer by training: B.E. or B.Tech in computer science or IT, MCA, or real hands-on coding experience
* 2 or more years in a customer-facing technical role at a software company: technical support, application support, implementation, solutions or customer success engineering
* You can read code and write some: JavaScript or Python scripts, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL or MongoDB queries
* You debug methodically and can explain what broke to a non-technical founder in plain words
* Clear spoken and written English, comfortable on calls with founders and operations teams
* You follow through. When a customer is waiting on something, they hear from you before they have to ask

**A major plus**

* Hands-on time with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Manager or a messaging platform such as Gupshup, Twilio, Wati or Interakt
* Shopify: the admin, apps, webhooks and how D2C brands run their stores
* Helpdesk and CRM tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or HubSpot
* You've set up or tuned an LLM-based product: prompts, knowledge bases, AI agents
* A stint as a developer before you moved into support or implementation

**How success is measured**

* New customers go live quickly and actually use what they bought
* The accounts you own renew and grow
* Problems get fixed at the root, so the same issue doesn't come back
* Engineering can act on your bug reports without a follow-up call

**The pace**

This is a high-intensity, high-performance role. Our customers move fast, the targets are clear and you own the outcome. If that sounds good to you, you'll fit in well here.

**Why join BotSpace**

You'll sit between our customers and our engineering team and work closely with the founders. You'll see how hundreds of brands use the product day to day, and what you learn goes straight into what we build next.

**How to apply**

Apply on our careers site. It takes about twenty minutes: a short form with your resume and LinkedIn, then 4 quick questions with our hiring assistant. We read every application and reply within a week.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Home Mantra is a real estate agency based in Wakad, Pune, supporting professionals, families, and investors in making informed property decisions across the Pune district. The company specializes in residential and commercial property sales, rental and leasing solutions, and investment consulting in Pune’s growing real estate market. title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
**We Offer**
The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.
  
  
For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.
  
  
For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.
  
  
The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.
  
  
**Tasks And Qualifications**

* WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%
* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.
* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.
* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.
* WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%
* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.
* WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%
* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.
* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.
* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.
* WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%
* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.
* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.
* Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%
* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.
* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.
* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.
* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.
* Incident and service-request coordination - 15%
* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.
* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.
* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.
* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.
* Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%
* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.
* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.
* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.
* Operational performance and service improvement - 5%
* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.
* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.
* Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training

Interfaces
  
  
**Internal**

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers
* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security
* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change
* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management
* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers
* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

**External**

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers
* Managed network and security service providers
* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners
* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
  
  
Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
  
  
Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. title: Careline Lead, Asia & METSA

All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. We are committed to developing and nurturing talent. You will have ample options for career growth and exploration. Your career development will be a priority for us, and we are dedicated to supporting your growth journey within the new company. ABOUT GBS: Global Business Solutions:   Global Business Solutions (GBS) is TMICC’s trusted transformation partner, delivering innovative and integrated solutions from design to delivery. We develop future-fit capability, expertise and technologically advanced solutions to unlock speed, simplicity and operational agility across TMICCs operations. This is your chance for a ‘once in a lifetime’ career experience, playing a part in the creation of a fully independent, new Ice Cream company and a greenfield GBS organization supporting Europe Supply Chain Finance Processes. Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. What you'll be responsible for Act as the primary point of contact between GBS Careline teams (Captive and/or 3PSP) and markets within the region (BU). Act as an additional layer of supervision of work performed by 3rd party vendor for daily services. Serve as the escalation point for operational risks, delays, or service failures, and coordinate crisis management, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication. Ensure Careline operations consistently follow TMICC global standards, processes, tools, timelines, communications, validating consistent implementation across the region. Monitor and govern region-level Careline operations performance using dashboards and reports, ensuring service delivery meets agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. Identify trends, risks, and root causes of underperformance, drive corrective actions, and promote continuous improvement across the region. Support markets during transitions, onboarding, and operating model changes, ensuring awareness, readiness, and alignment between the operations and local market requirements. Hold accountability for region-level budget governance, including vendor cost tracking, volume forecasting alignment, and identification of cost optimization opportunities. Manage stakeholder relationships across internal teams (Marketing, Legal, Supply Chain, Quality) and external partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables at the regional level. We're looking for someone who Practical experience in Consumer or Customer Engagement operations, with understanding of customer care processes, performance KPIs, and quality standards. Exposure to governance, coordination, or oversight roles within GBS, shared services, BPO, or complex multi market environment Team Manager experience in supervising team members (direct or 3rd party BPO). Ability to work across multiple countries or markets, supporting alignment with global standards, processes, and timelines. Experience supporting or coordinating transitions, operating model changes, or transformations, with a strong understanding of readiness, governance, and escalation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review performance dashboards, identify trends and risks, and drive follow up actions through stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, combined with a high ownership mindset and confidence to challenge and escalate where required. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

title: Digital Customer Success Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one-to-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement and cross-functional coordination to help customers realise value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
  
  
You will own the community and digital-engagement workstream, combining online community operations, structured customer outreach, content governance, customer-feedback enablement and engagement measurement. The role requires strong operational ownership, editorial judgement and disciplined stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Community platform ownership: Administer online customer community spaces, roles, permissions, onboarding, approvals, notifications, moderation and analytics.
* Community operations: Run operating cadences across multiple product communities and support new community launches.
* Content planning and publishing: Maintain content calendars and coordinate the sourcing, review, scheduling and publishing of value-led posts, polls, events, release information and webinar content.
* Stakeholder governance: Own recurring coordination with product and marketing stakeholders, including agendas, action tracking, approval routes and community roadmaps.
* Customer outreach: Execute structured customer introduction, invitation, re-engagement and information campaigns using validated contacts and account-owner alignment.
* VOC and NPS enablement: Coordinate pre-survey awareness, recipient alignment and follow-up inputs supporting customer-feedback programmes.
* Campaign operations: Manage shared mailboxes, communication templates, audience logic, response ownership and applicable opt-out or marketability controls.
* Community growth and advocacy: Increase qualified membership and participation and identify appropriate customer stories, testimonials and advocacy opportunities.
* Cross-functional coordination: Partner with account teams, Solution Consultants, Product Management, Product Marketing, IT and platform partners to remove dependencies.
* Measurement and continuity: Track membership, reach, publishing cadence, engagement and outreach response; maintain SOPs, access records and repositories.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Experience: 3–6 years in community management, digital customer engagement, customer marketing, Customer Success or comparable work.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Platform capability: Hands-on experience administering an online community or digital engagement platform.
* Content and communication: Strong professional writing, content curation and editorial judgement across posts, events, newsletters and customer communications.
* Campaign execution: Experience with structured email outreach, audience segmentation and basic communication-compliance concepts.
* Stakeholder management: Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups, approval flows, calendars and commitments with disciplined follow-through.
* Measurement: Ability to track and explain community or outreach performance using practical engagement metrics.
* Operating discipline: Strong organisation across trackers, minutes, action logs, content calendars and document repositories.
* Community platforms: Experience with Mighty Networks, Higher Logic, Khoros or a comparable platform.
* Customer feedback: Experience supporting VOC, NPS or broader customer-experience programmes.
* Growth programmes: Exposure to community analytics, advocacy, customer stories, event or webinar promotion.
* Business systems: Familiarity with CRM or a Customer Success platform and B2B enterprise software.
* Creative judgement: Basic design awareness for banners, landing pages and social-style content assets

title: Customer Renewal Manager
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Customer Renewal Manager (CRM) is responsible for driving the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for assigned customers in a defined Unit/Area. As part of Teradata’s Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline. The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.
  
  
The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy. The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities. The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. The CRM will align the renewal strategy with the Account Executive (AE), Customer Solution Architect (CSA) and wider account team to achieve optimal results.
  
  
A key responsibility of the CRM is completing and executing preventive actions on Cancellations and Erosions, leveraging early insights and collaborating with Field Technology Management, Services Delivery Management and Customer Services Management. The CRM will be responsible for the development, application and delivery of cancel and erosion save plans alongside the Customer Services Architect (CSA), with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention; in addition to the identification of upsell and cross sell.
  
  
As an integrated member of the GTM account team, this role is primarily responsible for retaining recurring revenue across Teradata’s business through exceptional renewal sales execution. This includes building and maintaining strong partnerships with both internal and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Renewal Scope Areas Include**
:
  
  

* Basic understanding of the components that make up a renewal in order to articulate the e2e solution.
* Understanding of sales process including managing account relationships and customer interaction.
* Renewals includes any revenue in Teradata that has been previously sold and should be retained through repeat contracting on a scheduled basis, including Term, Cloud, Maintenance and SWUR.
* Turn-key Renewals: CRM will own the oversight of the renewal process, managing customer engagement supported by the process from the back-office teams.
* Upsell/Cross-Sell/New-Sell: In certain circumstances the CRM will own the sales cycle for the generation of new revenue. This will be part of the normal renewal lifecycle in accounts, where there is opportunity to expand the scope of the renewal to new business, like increasing a customer support Success Tier and Cloud services.
* Customer Presentations: Prepare and deliver customer presentations to align with business objectives and ensure common understanding of scope of work and renewal strategy. Renewal Contract documentation: Be responsible for overseeing or/and preparation & development of renewal contract/SOW as necessary.
* Technical knowledge of database systems, operating systems (desirable)

**Account planning, selling and negotiating are core elements of success in this role. This role will focus on:**

* Effective account planning and renewal preparation, leveraging the entire Teradata portfolio to protect and drive recurring revenue growth
* Renewing Teradata's recurring revenue footprint with existing customers with on-time accuracy and oversight of all contract lifecycle management activities
* Creation and execution of Cancel and Erosion save plans, with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention.
* Maintaining forecast accuracy and participating in Sales Outlook cadence calls
* Participate in quarterly services delivery and operational excellence reviews
* Capable of understanding Teradata analytic technology, to find the customer value and competitive position that drives price in opportunities for customer use of Teradata products and services
* Creative thinker able to come up with alternatives that increase offer effectiveness and protect current and future price realization
* Ability to work closely with sales and sales management, and draw on other company resources
* The ability to professionally discuss business issues with management and offer advice and alternatives
* Ability to review and interpret complex contract/customer agreement detail

It will be vital for the CRM to build strong relationships and drive collaboration with other functions in the business.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* BSc/BA degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 5 years related work experience

**What You Bring**

* Demonstrated sales success managing account relationships and developing new account opportunities
* Ability to work with multiple Customers at the same time including capturing each engagement’s discussions, notes, follow-up, issues, etc.
* Ability to work successfully at the intersection of business, technology and services and translate/communicate across both
* Presence: enthusiastic and high energy, but also poised, confident and extremely professional
* Innovative and assertive, with the ability to pick up new technologies and assess situations quickly
* Fluent in the following tools:
* Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, ERP, Install Base and Contract Lifecycle Management solutions
* Advanced interpersonal, listening and communication skills, including presentation and facilitation skills, and a track record of effectively communicating with and influencing at all levels
* Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven project and time management skills with ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Demonstrate personal and professional values consistent with Teradata’s values.
* Be highly collaborative, transparent, organised, detail oriented and a stickler for accuracy

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Manager, Identity Maturity Acceleration
description:
**Why SailPoint?**

Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and we have the awards to prove it. If you’re passionate about outsmarting cybercriminals and working at a company where you can truly have an impact, we want you to join our team.

SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Center of Security and IT.  Our 2,000+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.

**About the role:**

SailPoint is the leading AI-driven identity security platform delivering autonomous governance to secure the modern enterprise. We provide unified security across the human fabric (employees, contractors, partners) and the emerging agentic/non-human fabric (autonomous AI agents, machine identities, service accounts).

Within SailPoint’s Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) organization, the Manager, Agentic Identity Acceleration is a high-impact, client-facing growth role designed for an ambitious, humble, and technically grounded professional ready to step into practice leadership.

In this customer-facing role, you will partner with our elite Technical Advisors (TAs) to guide enterprise clients through modern identity governance, AI agent security, and maturity acceleration using the SailPoint Agentic Fabric and SailPoint Atlas. This role offers a clear path to develop your executive advisory presence, lead strategic client programs, and grow into a full-scale practice leader.

**What You Will Do**

Client Advisory & Program Acceleration (60%)

* Executive Partnership & Steering Committees: Partner with client IAM leaders, CISOs, and enterprise stakeholders to run steering committees, track program milestones, and communicate business value across human and agentic identity programs.

* Support & Amplify Technical Advisors: Work hand-in-hand with designated Technical Advisors on key enterprise accounts—handling engagement planning, stakeholder alignment, and operational health so the TA can lead technical architecture with CISOs and AI Officers.

* Maturity Framework Guidance: Help clients assess and progress along the Identity Maturity Acceleration (IMA) curve, moving from foundational governance (Horizons 1–2) toward advanced, automated security (Horizons 4–5).

* Engagement Health & Scope Governance: Monitor delivery health, identify risks early, and coordinate with Delivery Partners and System Integrators to ensure engagements stay on track and deliver on contracted outcomes.

* GTM & Scoping Collaboration: Work alongside Sales, Sales Engineering, and Agentic Technology Specialists (ATS) to assist in scoping Advisory and Delivery Assurance proposals.

Practice Development & Growth (40%)

* Mentorship & Team Coordination: Coordinate day-to-day engagement assignments, mentor junior team members, and foster a collaborative, high-trust team culture.

* AI-Augmented Operational Learning: Eagerly adopt and test internal AI accelerators (e.g., Harbor Pilot), automated workflows, and agentic tools to make practice reporting and status tracking faster and more efficient.

* Field Insights Feedback: Gather feedback and emerging use cases from client interactions to help Product and GTM teams refine our Agentic Fabric offerings.

* Continuous Personal Development: Actively seek coaching from senior leadership to expand your executive presence, C-level communication, and commercial acumen.

**Who You Are (Qualifications & Mindset)**

* Hungry, Humble & Curious: You bring strong self-awareness, low ego, and high intellectual curiosity. You love learning new technologies (especially AI and identity) and are eager to prove yourself in a leadership capacity.

* Experience Baseline: 5 –10+ years of progressive experience in IAM/IGA, Cybersecurity consulting, Technical Account Management, or SaaS Professional Services.

* Technical & Domain Foundation: Solid foundational knowledge of Identity Governance, access lifecycles (JML), cloud security, and an eager appetite to master Non-Human Identities (NHI) and autonomous AI agent concepts.

* Consultative Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings, present project findings clearly, and navigate stakeholder expectations.

* Project & Delivery Organization: Demonstrated experience managing multiple client projects, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and maintaining engagement momentum.

* Leadership Potential: Prior experience informally mentoring peers, leading project squads, or acting as a lead consultant, with a clear desire to grow into people management.

**Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.**

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

The Account Manager will be accountable for the overall satisfaction with GPS produts and services and support the broadening and deepening of these client relationships to drive commercial outcomes for the GPS business.
  
  
This includes overseeing execution of query management for the client, oversight of transactional activity, providing insights to clients on how to optimize through Client Service Reviews, coordination of a clients global Treasury and Cash Management initiatives and projects, and proactively managing the GPS client relationship on a day to day basis. Depending on the complexity and geography of the client this role will either lead the client relationship or play a supporting role on a global squad covering the client.

* Manage the liquidity and cash management needs of a portfolio of Financial Institutions, Multi-National Corporations and Local Corporates. Maintain relationships with key influencers in the client’s local or regional Treasury and Finance organisation.
* Be accountable for the retention of annual revenue of your portfolio of clients, including capturing opportunities and supporting growth of your clients (revenue targets included in scorecard)
* Accountable for the identification of opportunities to deliver Client Service excellence locally and regionally; effectively managing any risks and issues.
* Responsible for resolving assigned queries.
* Accountable for monitoring and guiding the completion of all global queries and local basic queries that may be assigned to others.
* The role holder must have a strong understanding of the cash management business including identifying and dealing with actual or potential business or relationship risks.
* Strong written and oral communication skills; must be able to put complex product and/or technical information into simple terms.
* Maintain a client footprint with the basic information required to deliver a superior client experience.

**Senior Account Manager**
In addition to the above activities, the
**Senior Account Manager**

**Qualifications**

* Proven ability in identifying and meeting customer needs through matching a broad range of products and services.
* Ability to understand a customer’s business and the fundamentals of running a business.

* Strong range of communication skills, including written, verbal, and the ability to deliver compelling presentations.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a complex matrix environment with several stakeholders with differing goals/expectations.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced work environment; continually changing lines of communication, technological advances etc.

* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to travel.

**Desirable**

* Previous banking experience working with FIs/Corporates in a relationship or account management role. Specific experience with large multi-national corporations or financial institutions including Global/Regional HQ names will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of day-to-day workings of a Corporate Treasury environment, foreign exchange, intercompany loans, payroll, and payments.
* Knowledgeable about our competitors’ products and services, strategies, and client relationship practices.
* Broad knowledge of HSBC Group companies and product ranges

Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

**What We Offer**

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Bit about us

At Progreva, our mission is to be a leading progressive, values-driven organization that transforms the employee experience, whether in the office, at home or wherever our people choose to work. Our employees’ and contractors’ well-being comes first.

We’re building a culture of camaraderie, work-life balance and empathy, where people feel comfortable, confident and empowered, with the ownership, space and autonomy to succeed.

We believe that when we take great care of our people, they take exceptional care of our clients. That’s why we work only with clients who share our employee-centric values. And yes, we also build breakthrough digital products for our global clients, and have fun along the way!

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Engagement Manager**
to lead Progreva’s engagement with a global energy-technology enterprise, delivered through our European delivery partner. The role has three parts:

·      a
**hands-on consultant**
embedded in the client’s IT organisation

·      a
**trusted advisor**
who helps application owners modernise their systems and grows the account

·      the
**people lead**
for the Progreva engineers on the programme

You will help the client’s application managers put their needs into words, show them what modern technology makes possible, and turn that into well-scoped work for our team. You will also build the same consultative, opportunity-spotting mindset in our engineers.

Responsibilities:

Client-facing Business Analysis

·      Work inside the client’s IT organisation as a
**billable business analyst / application consultant**
, first alongside an experienced Progreva consultant, then on your own.

·      Run
**requirement workshops**
with application managers and users, and turn their needs into user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised backlogs.

·      Create and maintain
**application documentation**
: functional specs, process flows, architecture overviews, user guides and runbooks.

·      Find
**security and compliance gaps**
(penetration-test findings, access management, outdated components) and coordinate the fixes.

Account Growth & Solutioning

·      Map the client’s applications, understand each product’s users and roadmap, and spot pain points early.

·      Shape
**modernisation opportunities**
: .NET upgrades, cloud migration, UX redesign, test automation and QA, AI automation, data platforms, dashboards and analytics.

·      Turn opportunities into
**scoped proposals**
(problem, solution, estimate, business value), and work with Progreva leadership and our delivery partner to turn them into statements of work.

·      
**Coach engineers**
to spot improvement opportunities in their own products, run regular opportunity reviews, and collect each application’s annual roadmap.

·      Maintain the
**account opportunity pipeline**
and report growth progress to Progreva leadership.

Team Management

·      
**Set clear goals and expectations**
, track individual and team performance, and give regular feedback and support for career development.

·      
**Handle escalations**
as the first point of contact for delivery issues, and own
**account growth**
alongside Progreva leadership.

·      Support
**hiring, onboarding, documentation and knowledge transfer**
, so the team keeps the right skills and continuity across locations.

·      Coordinate plans, timelines, dependencies and status reporting so that commitments are
**delivered on time and to quality**
.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

·      Build long-term relationships with application managers, IT leadership and our delivery partner’s account team.

·      Run regular account and service reviews covering delivery, team health, risks and opportunities.

·      
**Travel to Europe**
when needed (up to 1 month per year) for workshops, planning and partner meetings.

An ideal candidate:

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or IT. An MBA is a plus.

**Skills:**

·      
**6–10 years in IT services**
, including 3+ years in a client-facing BA, consultant, project manager or customer success role, and
**2+ years leading a small team**
.

·      A
**proven track record of growing an account**
by finding, scoping and winning follow-on work.

·      Enough
**technical grounding**
to talk credibly with engineers about software development, cloud, databases, APIs, data/BI and application security. No coding is expected.

·      Strong at
**requirements elicitation and documentation**
, using tools such as Jira/Azure DevOps and Confluence.

·      A
**consultative communicator**
with excellent English, comfortable advising senior business and technical stakeholders without overselling.

·      A natural
**people leader**
who sets clear expectations, gives honest feedback and keeps a distributed team motivated.

·      Familiar with Agile/Scrum. CBAP, SAFe PO/PM, PSM/CSM or PMP is a plus.

·      Experience with
**European clients**
, or in the
**energy, utilities, manufacturing or industrial**
domain, is a strong advantage.

·      Comfortable working
**CET hours**
.

What is in it for you?

·      Helping build an employee-centric, values-driven organization

·      Being part of a growing start-up that is setting new standards for employee well-being while delivering breakthrough digital products

·      Working in an international, distributed environment for industry-leading clients

·      A hybrid setup: 3 days a week at our Baner, Pune office and 2 days from home

·      Working as part of a large client organization, with interesting challenges every day, rather than in an “outsourced model”

·      A competitive salary, a performance-based incentive and a
**healthy work-life balance**

·      A
**visible leadership role**
with direct access to the founder and room to grow as the account grows

How to Apply:

Send your resume and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the
**Engagement Manager**
role to hr@progreva.com. During the interview process you’ll also speak with members of our team to learn about our culture and values. We’ll keep interviewing until we find the right person, so if you’ve read this far, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Are you a customer-centric professional with a strong technical aptitude and exceptional communication skills, eager to take on the challenges of managing relationships with clients in a dynamic environment? If so, you would want to join our team as a Senior Technical Account Manager to play a crucial role in driving customer success and adoption of Nutanix products, while working in a collaborative, supportive culture alongside experienced professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Senior Technical Account Manager will be joining the APAC iTAM team at Nutanix, which is based in Pune. This team is dedicated to providing exceptional support and service to customers across the APAC region, fostering a strong customer-centric culture characterized by collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect. The mission of the team is to drive customer success and maximize the value of Nutanix products, ensuring that clients realize their full potential and return on investment through proactive engagement and expert guidance.
  
  
You will report to the Manager of Technical Account Management. The work setup for this role is primarily remote, with the expectation that all team members will be based in Pune to cater to the needs of customers across the region.
  
  
For this role, travel is not a primary requirement; however, there may be occasional travel within India based on customer needs for face-to-face meetings. The position primarily involves remote service delivery to customers, maintaining the flexibility to accommodate varying customer preferences.
  
  
Your Role
  
  

* Create a good understanding of the customer’s installed base in terms of licenses consumed/activated, asset refresh opportunities, capacity utilization, software versions, support tickets, features adopted etc.
* Drive increased product adoption, and experience by doing the following:
* Recommend use of features, use cases, and increased capacity utilization by providing insights on usage maturity, and recommending best practices
* Coordinate with Support and Engineering resources to ensure critical support issues are treated with appropriate urgency and visibility
* Identify training needs for the customer and help orchestrate training/boot camps for customers
* Identify the need to upgrade to the latest software versions and support the creation of an upgrade plan for the customer
* Recommend and/or perform health checks, as needed
* Pull in expert Nutanix resources for conducting deeper dives with the customer. Orchestrate the breadth of Nutanix resources (Delivery/Consulting, Support, Architects) as needed

This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 2 - 3 days per week, however certain roles and/or teams may require more frequent in-office presence. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
  
  
What You Will Bring
  
  

* 6-10 years of work experience, preferably in technical customer-facing roles (Support engineer, Systems engineer, Technical account manager)
* Strong knowledge of virtualization, cloud computing, and data center technologies (Nutanix Stack preferred)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-centric attitude.
* High technical aptitude with understanding of infrastructure (storage, compute, network).
* Experience working in a customer-facing role, with a focus on account management.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and manage customer relationships long-term.
* Ability to drive a consultative conversation with the customer
* BE/B.Tech, advanced degree a plus

Work Arrangement
  
  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: Water Domain Business Lead
description:
**Job Title**
: Water Domain Business Lead

**Location**
: India (Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Delhi)

**Job Summary**

The Water Domain Business Lead is responsible for building and growing strategic client relationships across the water and wastewater utilities sector. The role combines domain leadership, consultative business development, account planning, solution shaping, and ecosystem collaboration to create qualified demand and convert opportunities into sustainable revenue. The position acts as a trusted business advisor to clients, connects business priorities with TCS capabilities, and orchestrates cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, outcome-led propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Achieves Revenue & Pipeline Targets through Demand Creation**

* Identify and develop demand across water and wastewater utilities by connecting client priorities with relevant TCS capabilities, industry solutions, digital engineering, IoT, data, cloud, asset management, operational technology, and transformation services.
* Build and maintain a healthy, qualified opportunity pipeline through executive conversations, account workshops, industry insights, targeted campaigns, partner propositions, and proactive solution concepts.
* Lead opportunity origination and early-stage qualification, establish business value, define the buying context, and shape a clear path from client need to funded initiative.
* Work with sales, accounts, consulting, delivery, solution, and partner teams to improve conversion from lead to qualified opportunity and from opportunity to closure.
* Monitor the pipeline for value, probability, ageing, competitive position, decision milestones, and dependencies, and initiate timely recovery actions where required.

**2 Ownership of Targets**

* Own agreed revenue, order-book, pipeline, and demand-generation targets for the water domain, with clear accountability for performance and forecast accuracy.
* Translate annual business objectives into account-level and solution-level pursuits, measurable milestones, and disciplined execution plans.
* Maintain visibility of target attainment, risks, gaps, and corrective actions, and provide evidence-based updates to leadership.
* Balance short-term pursuit conversion with medium-term pipeline development and long-term strategic account growth.

**3 Positions TCS as Business Advisor**

* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business strategy, operational challenges, regulatory context, investment priorities, technology landscape, and transformation agenda.
* Engage client executives and business leaders with a point of view on sector trends, operational resilience, customer and environmental outcomes, asset performance, data-led decision-making, and digital transformation.
* Create client-specific value propositions, business cases, roadmaps, maturity assessments, and executive narratives that clearly link TCS capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
* Bring relevant TCS experience, reusable assets, alliances, and cross-industry innovation into client discussions without presenting generic or technology-led propositions.
* Build credibility through domain depth, commercial awareness, structured problem solving, and consistent follow-through.

**4 Alliance Led Growth**

* Define and execute alliance-led growth strategies for the water domain by aligning TCS capabilities with complementary technology, engineering, platform, and industry-partner offerings.
* Identify priority alliance partners and jointly develop differentiated propositions, market plays, account-entry strategies, and repeatable solution patterns for water and wastewater utilities.
* Create joint go-to-market plans covering target clients, demand-generation campaigns, executive engagement, workshops, demonstrations, thought leadership, and industry events.
* Work with alliance, sales, consulting, solution, and delivery teams to originate and qualify partner-influenced opportunities and establish clear ownership across the pursuit lifecycle.
* Develop joint value propositions and business cases that define the client outcome, combined capabilities, delivery responsibilities, commercial model, and competitive differentiation.
* Maintain governance for alliance pursuits, including opportunity tracking, pipeline contribution, partner commitments, solution dependencies, risks, and agreed next actions.
* Strengthen partner relationships through regular business reviews, shared account planning, solution enablement, credential development, and structured knowledge exchange.

**5 Collaboration & Networking**

* Create effective virtual teams across sales, account management, consulting, delivery, engineering, industry units, centers of excellence, alliances, and marketing.
* Build a strong internal network to mobilize the right subject-matter experts, credentials, accelerators, and leadership sponsorship for each opportunity.
* Develop relationships with technology and industry partners to shape complementary propositions and strengthen market access.
* Encourage knowledge sharing across geographies and accounts, including reuse of proven case studies, solution patterns, lessons learned, and proposal content.
* Represent the water domain in relevant client forums, internal communities, industry events, and partner engagements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, environmental sciences, business, or a related discipline.

A postgraduate qualification in business, management, utilities, or a related field is desirable.

**Experience**

* 10+ experience in the water and wastewater utilities sector, with a strong understanding of utility business, operational, asset, customer, environmental, and regulatory priorities.
* Proven experience in business development, consulting, client relationship management, account growth, solution shaping, or strategic sales in a complex B2B environment with $20M+ target achievement.
* Demonstrated ability to originate and qualify opportunities, influence senior stakeholders, coordinate multi-disciplinary teams, and support complex pursuits through closure.
* Experience developing client-specific propositions, business cases, account plans, executive presentations, and proposal responses.
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams, alliance partners, and delivery organizations is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Water and wastewater utility domain knowledge, including core business processes and the operating context of asset-intensive utilities.
* Working knowledge of digital utility capabilities such as operational technology and IT convergence, SCADA and telemetry, IoT, data platforms, analytics and AI, GIS, asset management, digital twins, cloud, and cyber security.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, value drivers, implementation roadmaps, and differentiated propositions.
* Strong capability in opportunity qualification, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, commercial awareness, and proposal governance.
* Proficiency in creating executive-ready presentations, structured documents, business cases, and management reports.
* Soft Skills
* Executive presence and the ability to communicate credibly with business, operational, and technology stakeholders.
* Consultative listening, structured problem solving, commercial judgement, and a strong client-outcome orientation.
* Influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to align stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Collaboration, cultural awareness, adaptability, resilience, and disciplined follow-through.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and attention to detail.

**Measures of Success**

* Achievement of agreed revenue, order-book, qualified-pipeline, and demand-creation outcomes.
* Quality, coverage, progression, and forecast accuracy of the water-domain opportunity pipeline.
* Growth in strategic client relationships, executive access, and TCS participation in priority transformation initiatives.
* Conversion of differentiated propositions into qualified pursuits and successful outcomes.
* Effectiveness of cross-functional collaboration, governance adherence, and leadership reporting.
* Contribution to reusable water-domain assets, thought leadership, partner propositions, and team capability.
